decision_question: Can a label-independent three-role cross-fit learn a seasonal exact-no-op veto for the sealed supervised rank-1 correction without using outer validation outcomes?
comparator_disclosure: Official alpha50 has no exact historical OOF lineage. This evaluates a veto over sealed historical predictions against the frozen forward alpha50 proxy only; it is not an official or Private transport claim.

crossfit.partition: sorted unique complete target-profile timestamps split into three contiguous equal-count groups
crossfit.reference_support_rule: target-layer temp/psal outside the reference-support group are jointly masked before reference fitting
crossfit.held_truth_rule: held-group truth is bound only after its prediction vector is computed

provenance.title: Double/Debiased Machine Learning for Treatment and Causal Parameters
provenance.claim: Cross-fitting uses sample splitting so predictions for a held fold are produced by nuisance fits that exclude that fold; this motivates, but does not make this experiment DML.

provenance.title: Stacked Generalization
provenance.claim: A second-level decision should be trained on out-of-sample base predictions, motivating held-group loss estimates rather than in-sample correction losses.

provenance.title: When No-Rejection Learning is Consistent for Regression with Rejection
provenance.claim: A rejector can be trained from validation empirical losses separately from the predictor, motivating the frozen correction plus exact-no-op veto.

provenance.title: Selective Regression under Fairness Criteria
provenance.claim: Selective coverage can hide subgroup harm, motivating explicit fold and layer veto gates.
